title: Fisher–Yates shuffle: backward swaps
requirements: Use fixtures/shuffle_storyboard.json: eight illustrative cards, indices 0–7; make the reduced-size example explicit.
At each step highlight i, the allowed j range 0…i, the selected j, and the temporary Card used during the swap.
Include a self-swap, which is allowed. After each iteration, the fixed suffix grows; never choose j above i.
End with the real-code bounds i=51 down to 1 and Rnd.Next(0, i + 1), stating the latter as source code rather than hiding the +1.
Do not use this deterministic teaching trace as statistical evidence of unbiasedness or invent benchmark claims.
beats: 0–3 s: label the eight-card illustration and indices.
3–15 s: execute all seven stored swaps, with extra hold on first swap and self-swap.
15–18 s: show final permutation and locked suffix.
18–21 s: connect the miniature to the 52-card code.
checks: All fixture steps are followed and final order matches the fixture.
Cards are permuted, never duplicated or deleted.
Every j is inside 0…i and a fixed suffix card is not swapped later.
A historical “1938” caption is excluded pending verification.
